test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Ripan’s nature and his __strange habits__ can often unintentionally hurt others.
solution: The correct answer is: **Eccentricity** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Eccentricity **means unconventional and slightly strange behaviour. (अपरंपरागत और थोड़ा अजीब व्यवहार) • **For example-** *He was known as Mad Shelley partly because of his eccentricity and partly because of his violent temper.* • The sentence is referring to Ripan's unconventional habits that unintentionally hurt others. • Eccentricity fits perfectly in the context and conveys the intended meaning. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Let us look at the meaning of the other words. • **Anomaly **means something that deviates from what is standard, normal, or expected. (कुछ ऐसा जो मानक, सामान्य या अपेक्षित से भटक जाता है) • **Abnormality **means the quality or state of being abnormal. (असामान्य होने की गुणवत्ता या अवस्था) • **Beatnik **means a person who participates in a social movement characterized by unconventional dress and behaviour, and avant-garde art and literature. (एक व्यक्ति जो अपरंपरागत पोशाक और व्यवहार, और अवंत-गार्डे कला और साहित्य की विशेषता वाले सामाजिक आंदोलन में भाग लेता है) 4c:Tceb, The correct answer is: **Scholarly**
